SEARCH
程序包 org.bukkit

接口 TravelAgent

public interface TravelAgent
The Travel Agent handles the creation and the research of Nether and End portals when Entities try to use one. 传送代理（Travel Agent）负责在实体尝试使用下界或末地传送门时，处理传送门的创建与查找。

It is used in EntityPortalEvent and in PlayerPortalEvent to help developers reproduce and/or modify Vanilla behaviour. 它用于 EntityPortalEvent 和 PlayerPortalEvent，帮助开发者重现和/或修改原版行为。

    • findOrCreate

      Location findOrCreate(Location location)
      Attempt to find a portal near the given location, if a portal is not found it will attempt to create one. 尝试在给定位置附近查找传送门，若未找到则会尝试创建一个。
      参数:
      location - the location where the search for a portal should begin 开始搜索传送门的位置
      返回:
      the location of a portal which has been found or returns the location passed to the method if unsuccessful 找到的传送门的位置，若失败则返回传入本方法的位置
      另请参阅:
      • createPortal(Location)

    • findPortal

      Location findPortal(Location location)
      Attempt to find a portal near the given location. 尝试在给定位置附近查找传送门。
      参数:
      location - the desired location of the portal 期望的传送门位置
      返回:
      the location of the nearest portal to the location 距离该位置最近的传送门的位置

    • createPortal

      boolean createPortal(Location location)
      Attempt to create a portal near the given location. 尝试在给定位置附近创建传送门。

      In the case of a Nether portal teleportation, this will attempt to create a Nether portal. 若是下界传送门传送，则会尝试创建一个下界传送门。

      In the case of an Ender portal teleportation, this will (re-)create the obsidian platform and clean blocks above it. 若是末地传送门传送，则会（重新）创建黑曜石平台并清理其上方的方块。

      参数:
      location - the desired location of the portal 期望的传送门位置
      返回:
      true if a portal was successfully created 如果传送门创建成功则为 true
